name: @gcu/archive
description: Archive format handling for the GCU stack — ZIP, tar, tar.gz, tar.zst, gz, zst with optional lazy xz/bz2. Source-agnostic API (VFS, in-memory, streams) used by Auditable Works for native archive workflows and by @gcu/coreutils to back tar / gzip / unzip builtins.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
